_comment: The environment the agent works in. Agent code holds no app-specific URLs or risk vocabulary: they live here. See agent/world.py.
description: Company intranet start page: {start_url}  (links to webmail, the internal ERP and the IT helpdesk)

apps._comment: Where each application lives (URL path prefix) and what it holds. The auditor uses this to decide which app the authoritative source of a task's values is in, from the task text alone; a source page must be in one of those apps. 'workspace' (shared files) is always available.

mail.about: corporate webmail of the AP mailbox: vendor invoices, requests, notices

acme.about: Acme Supplies' vendor portal: Acme's invoices

erp.about: the internal ERP: bills (invoices entered), vendors, payments

helpdesk.about: the IT helpdesk: tickets, comments, employee directory

high_risk._comment: Approval required in balanced/supervised mode. button_words: whole words in a button's label. path_segments: a non-GET request whose path has this segment. path_substrings / field_substrings: anywhere in the path / in a submitted form field's name.
